parameters: You're not leaving me yet, Zelos...
Heh...\| I think you know what this means.\! The barrier between worlds is soon going to shatter, and Zanatus will return.\! What we saw today was just a small projection of the demon's power.
Then it seems we're going to have to kill Zanatus, huh?
\n[8] and Zelos back together, trying to kill a god...\| I guess there are worse ways to die.
Is it true, what he said about the Nephilim?
If so, I suppose that would make me the fool for believing in fate.\! You'd like that, wouldn't you?
